null หมายถึงยังไม่ได้ยืนยันข้อมูล ไม่ได้หมายความว่าไม่มีข้อมูลบนผู้ให้บริการ
ไม่ควรใช้ Spotify album ID/URL ที่ยังไม่ตรวจสอบเป็นลิงก์จริง; ค่า URL ของบางอัลบั้มถูกเว้นไว้

notes: This is a useful starter catalog, not a verified exhaustive discography.
Some songs are grouped under a collection of singles because the exact release/album association still needs checking.
A few songs may appear more than once when they are listed both as an album track and a separate single; deduplicate by recording/provider ID after verification.
Null means not yet verified. Do not treat it as evidence that the provider lacks the item.
Track durations and release years should be verified against provider pages before production use.
Metadata, cover artwork, and provider links do not grant rights to stream copyrighted audio.
